verses.1:
A song of ascents.
 When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, + 126:1 Or brought back the captives to Zion or restored the fortunes of Zion we were like dreamers. + 126:1 Or like those restored to health
verses.2:
Then our mouths were filled with laughter,
 our tongues with shouts of joy.
 Then it was said among the nations,
 “The LORD has done great things for them.”
verses.3:
The LORD has done great things for us;
 we are filled with joy.
verses.4:
Restore our captives, + 126:4 Or Restore our fortunes O LORD,
 like streams in the Negev.
verses.5:
Those who sow in tears
 will reap with shouts of joy.
verses.6:
He who goes out weeping,
 bearing a trail of seed,
 will surely return with shouts of joy,
 carrying sheaves of grain.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
